segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ ״הֲרֵינִי נָזִיר מִן הַחַרְצַנִּים״ וּ״מִן הַזַּגִּים״ וּ״מִן הַתִּגְלַחַת״ וּ״מִן הַטּוּמְאָה״ — הֲרֵי זֶה נָזִיר, וְכׇל דִּקְדּוּקֵי נְזִירוּת עָלָיו.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one said: «I am hereby a nazirite» and therefore will refrain «from» grape «seeds, or:» I am hereby a nazirite and therefore will refrain «from» grape «skins, or: From shaving, or: From impurity, he is a nazirite. And all details of naziriteship» are incumbent «upon him.» Not only does the prohibition he mentioned take effect, he is bound by all of the strictures of naziriteship.

moves.summary: one vowing a partial naziriteship is a full nazirite

positions.claim: a partial nazirite vow binds all nazirite strictures
